rejectCriteria: plant leaves or leaf veins used as plates
single smooth sail or continuous scalloped fan
connected sawtooth wall of plates with only painted seam lines
thin comb-like spines instead of broad plates
missing or cropped thagomizer when tail is visible
fewer or more than four tail spikes when the thagomizer is visible
second head, face, or horned head on the tail
turtle shell or ankylosaur armor shell
extra legs, duplicate limbs, duplicate tails, text, logo, signature, border, or lower-corner artifacts
dorsal plates with the same leather-like color or texture as the skin
tail spikes lying flat or parallel to the ground instead of rising into paired upward V shapes
radial starburst or compass-rose thagomizer spikes
any thagomizer spike or tail-point lying parallel to the ground or horizon
tail shaft continuing as a straight horizontal point beyond the thagomizer
three upward spikes plus a small side nub instead of four countable upward spikes
rejectionPatterns: lower thagomizer spike lying along the tail shaft instead of rising upward relative to the ground
five-spike or radial thagomizer cluster even when the direction is more upward
